retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, film-grain band portrait featuring a staggered diagonal lineup of subjects with distressed, ultra-condensed typography in the lower right quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, shallow-depth-of-field photograph of four individuals arranged in a receding diagonal line from left to right. The primary subject in the foreground has messy, voluminous hair and a melancholic expression, while the others fade into a soft-focus background. The image is characterized by heavy film grain, a desaturated palette of browns, greys, and blacks, and a prominent vertical typographic block in a rusted orange hue.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal recession of faces creating depth
High-contrast texture between smooth skin and gritty film grain
Color harmony between the muted background and the rusted orange text
Tight framing that crops the subjects' shoulders and hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large foreground female face on the left occupying 40% of the frame; three male faces receding diagonally toward the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The foreground subject's eyes and the vertical text block in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the foreground face, follows the diagonal line of faces upward and right, then drops down to the bold vertical text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and charcoal greys (background and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with mid-to-dark values; high local contrast due to film grain.

letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent baseline and cap height for a 'stamped' look
Heavy distressing and erosion on edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'L' and 'E' have shortened horizontal bars to maintain the narrow profile
Internal counters are extremely thin slits
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage; the texture of the type matches the grain of the photo.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the woodblock, condensed western feel
Provides the necessary extreme verticality and weight
Offers the rugged, condensed editorial look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy 35mm film photograph of four people in a staggered diagonal line. The foreground person is a woman with messy 80s hair looking at the camera. The others are men receding into the background with shallow focus. Use a palette of charcoal, brown, and pale skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-condensed, distressed woodblock-style text in the lower right corner. Color the text a muted terracotta orange. Ensure the text has a stamped, eroded texture that blends with the film grain.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain prominent and consistent?
Are the faces arranged in a clear diagonal recession?
Is the typography vertically elongated and distressed?
Is the color palette restricted to muted earth tones?

postGenerationChecks: Check for heavy film grain texture across the entire image.
Ensure the text is ultra-condensed and vertically stacked.
Verify the diagonal composition of the subjects.
Confirm the muted, desaturated color grading.
recipe.reuseFormula: Staggered diagonal portrait + heavy film grain + ultra-condensed distressed slab-serif typography in lower right.
